title: Shaheed-e-Karbala Hussain, Hussain Hussain Imam Hussain
body:
Kitha Bachri Mushkil Kusha Da Hay
Aa Behn Di Qaid Chura Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Ali Abid Zevar Paye Nay
Aa Shaam Di Rah Dikhla Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Batil Diyan Jhirkan Pehgaye Ay
Masooma Khaak Tay Behgaye Ay
Aa Dhi Kun Gal Nal Laa Hussain
